# ACTIVE GYM Levice

> ACTIVE GYM is a self-service gym (samoobslužné fitness) at Vojenská 114, 934 01 Levice, Slovakia. It is open every day of the year with entry from 5:00 to 20:30, using a personal QR code in the ACTIVE GYM app. There is no reception: new members register in person at a meeting arranged via WhatsApp (+421 908 376 297).

The website is available in Slovak (main language) and English.

## Key facts

- Name: ACTIVE GYM (ACTIVE GYM Levice)
- Type: self-service gym without reception, Slovak: samoobslužné fitness centrum
- Address: Vojenská 114, 934 01 Levice, Slovakia
- Entry hours: every day 5:00 – 20:30, including holidays (365 days a year); members must leave by 22:00
- Phone and WhatsApp: +421 908 376 297
- Email: albina.masarykova@gmail.com
- Founder: Jozef Masaryk, professional athlete, Slovak Special Forces
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/activegymlevice/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/active_gym_levice/
- Parking in front of the gym; bus stop "ul. Vojenská MŠ" is a 2-minute walk

## Prices (all prices include VAT)

- Deposit (credit) membership: from €10, valid 1 year, single entry €3.60, minimum deposit €10
- 1 month: €32 per month, unlimited entry
- Students: €26 per month, unlimited entry, ISIC card required at registration

Every membership includes daily entry 5:00 – 20:30, the weights area and cardio zone, changing rooms with showers and lockers, and a personal QR code in the app. Memberships do not renew automatically and are personal and non-transferable.

## Facilities

- Premium Panatta and Vita strength machines
- Free-weights zone with racks
- Cardio zone: treadmills, rowing machine, elliptical trainer, bike
- Changing rooms with showers and lockers
- Sports nutrition for sale on site: Slovak FitBoom protein, pre-workouts, protein bars, isotonic drinks (pay by scanning the QR code under the product)

## How to join

1. Message or call the gym on WhatsApp: +421 908 376 297
2. Arrange a short personal meeting at the gym
3. Register on site and set up the ACTIVE GYM app; bring an ID card or passport, your phone, and cash or a card for the first membership (students also bring ISIC)
4. Enter with your personal QR code at the reader next to the entrance door

Registration is only possible in person, never online or in the app. Renewals are paid by card in the app, with no meeting needed.

## ACTIVE GYM app

- Free for iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/sk/app/active-gym-levice/id6466147681
- Free for Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.clubspire.android.activegymlevice
- The QR code also works offline
